text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Payments webhook failures spike (5m error rate 18%). Upstream Stripe API returning 429 / 403 for webhook deliveries. Flagged as P0 and auto-created incident thread. Notifying oncall.

oncall-anna: taking this. reading logs now — any customer-impact reports?

srini: seeing a lot of 429s with response body referencing quota enforcement:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {"type": "rate_limit", "message": "Requests blocked due to account quota enforcement"}
}
```

maya: Support dashboard shows ~120 customers with recent failed payment webhook deliveries in the last 20m. ~30 customers show subscription-state transitions stuck (access suspended).

sam: I opened an emergency ticket with Stripe, ticket #TKT-43121 (link: https://support.stripe.com/tickets/TKT-43121). They acknowledged rate limiting and said it's tied to a billing enforcement job on their side. ETA unclear.

payments-platform: Auto-mitigation: enabling polling fallback for webhook events for 50% of payment events to reduce delivery pressure. Queuing non-critical webhooks to SQS for delayed replay. Will log fallback activation.

julia: Support, please hold on targeted outreach drafts. Suggested customer note: "We're experiencing delayed payment processing and some subscription updates may be delayed. We're applying a temporary retry/polling fallback and will update when resolved." Keep it concise.

oncall-anna: plan: 1) Confirm extent of customer access impact (maya) 2) Maintain fallback poller + queue (payments-platform, sam) 3) Push status to status.redwood.ai and targeted customer emails (julia/support-bot) 4) Escalate to Stripe account manager (sam).

srini: quick diagnostic — run this query to list affected merchants and recent delivery codes:
```
SELECT merchant_id, count(*) as failures, array_agg(DISTINCT http_status) as codes
FROM webhook_deliveries
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND gateway = 'stripe'
GROUP BY merchant_id
ORDER BY failures DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

maya: running now — will paste top affected merchants in a sec. Preliminary: top 10 merchants account for ~60% of failures. Many of them are high-volume stores, which could have bumped Stripe's enforcement.

sam: executed fallback commands in prod (regions us-east-1, eu-west-1):
```
# enable polling fallback for stripe events
redwoodctl payments fallback enable --provider stripe --regions us-east-1,eu-west-1 --percent 50
# throttle outgoing webhook retries to avoid hammering stripe
redwoodctl payments webhook retry-config set --max-attempts 3 --backoff fixed
```

support-bot: Drafting customer message for targeted list. Ready to send on approval. Template attached.

julia: question — are any critical features completely blocked? e.g., license unlocks, subscription cancellations?

maya: yes: subscription cancellations and invoice-payment-succeeded webhooks are delayed. That caused access suspension for ~12 customers who had renewals fail. We can manually reconcile for highest-severity customers.

oncall-anna: action owners: maya -> list & manual recon for top 12 affected; sam -> stripe escalation + follow-ups; srini -> monitor delivery/error rates and evaluate whether reducing concurrency helps; julia/support-bot -> messaging; payments-platform -> ensure queue persistence and replay logic.

incident-bot: update 1867004520: Stripe status page shows degraded payments webhooks in some regions (https://status.stripe.com). They've posted a bulletin about quota enforcement on merchant accounts; they recommend contacting account owner to request quota review.

srini: small experiment: temporarily reduce concurrency of webhook workers to 10% for merchants with repeated 429 to reduce per-merchant burst. This will slow delivery but may lower chance of hitting Stripe enforcement. Will roll back if it increases latency too much.

sam: Stripe replied to ticket: "We see automated enforcement against several merchant accounts; we're expediting review but cannot guarantee immediate removal. We suggest reducing retry storms on webhook delivery and consolidating events." ETA 2-4 hours.

julia: Support will prepare two templates: 1) Internal ops note for customers with immediate revenue impact (manual reconcile offered) 2) Public status update. Approved by oncall.

oncall-anna: doing a handoff — I need to sleep in ~45m, will hand to srini. Srini, if Stripe updates with resolution, please post summary and route follow-up tasks.

srini: got it. I'll take over after 1867005700. Monitoring alert thresholds adjusted.

maya: manual recon list created: merchants A, B, C... (redacted). Team, drop affected merchant IDs into #payments-escalations for manual reconciliation.

sam: posted status update on status.redwood.ai: "Investigating delayed payment webhooks due to upstream quota enforcement from Stripe. Fallback polling enabled; targeted customers being contacted. Working with Stripe to restore normal delivery."

support-bot: sent targeted message to top 12 impacted merchants offering manual reconciliation and priority support.

incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev2 (customer-impacting, partial degradation). Logged timeline.

srini: follow-up checklist I'm tracking: 1) confirm reduced error rate 2) replay queued events after Stripe confirms unblocking 3) reconcile customer access states 4) postmortem w/ timeline + mitigation improvements (retry/backoff, circuit-breaker per-merchant)

oncall-anna: thanks team. If Stripe doesn't lift enforcement within 2 hours, escalate to execs and customer success for enterprise outreach.

sam: Stripe updated ticket at 1867005900: they removed enforcement for 3 merchants as part of review, investigating others. Keep queue intact; don't replay until we see stable 200 deliveries for several minutes.

srini: saw error rate drop to 4% in the last 5m after throttles and fallback. continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: final note for this thread (1867005975): Handoff complete to srini. Incident remains open. Please update the incident doc in /incidents/postmortems when resolved.
